supplier_questions_ordered: Is this quote DDP (you pay US duty) or DDU/DAP (duty billed to us or the customer)?
Can you confirm this is the manual hand-pump variant only, with no battery, motor or USB-rechargeable component?
What is the unit price for the bag set (state bag count and sizes) at 1 unit, at 10 units, and at 50 units (state FOB or ex-works)?
What is your processing/handling time before a tracked shipment is handed to the carrier?
What carrier and service do you use to a US address, and what is the stated transit time in days from handover to delivery?
Is end-to-end tracking provided to the US delivery address? Can you share a live tracking link for a recent shipment?
What is your return and defect policy for bags that fail to hold a seal or arrive punctured, or for a pump that fails?
What is the minimum order quantity, and is there a price break at higher volumes beyond 50 units?
What bag-count and size-mix variants exist, and do any carry a different unit price or MOQ?
What material is the bag film (nylon/PE laminate, PE only, etc.) and what is its rated shelf/seal life?
Will you send a single sample set before a bulk order, what does the sample cost, and what is the sample lead time?
